title: Multi-key writer gateway V7 simple scout
summary: Replace the near-C11 V6 implementation shell with a compact deterministic writer-capacity scout while preserving the complementary-map scientific core.
system_thesis: Before scaling parenting, test whether one rank-8 writer can carry several condition-dependent native actions rather than only a broad habit. Full custody machinery remains deferred to C11.

context_files.purpose: Normative scientific design, hygiene, tests, resources, and claim boundary.

nodes.before: V6 acquired correctness-selected child endpoints through a multi-principal source graph.
nodes.after: V7 deterministically materializes balanced complementary supervised ACT rows; child authorship is deferred.
nodes.rationale: Isolate writer conditional-routing capacity from source quality and avoid C11-like custody.

nodes.before: V6 required a 165-cell capability matrix, three dispatchers, a selector, a four-commit receipt, and exhaustive lifecycle faults.
nodes.after: V7 uses one lineage-isolated run root, immutable hashes, strict parser/canaries, atomic receipts, and independent review.
nodes.rationale: Match the supervisor's simple-hygiene ruling while retaining the causal controls.

edges.before: Correctness-selected child endpoints entered a guarded compiler.
edges.after: Exact complementary native-ACT rows enter four matched clean-base fits.
edges.rationale: Test the writer without attributing source authorship.

edges.after: Manifest-bound OFF/W+/W- held prompts, oracle, NLL, interface, and spill reads feed one sealed reducer.
edges.rationale: Retain decisive scientific contrasts with ordinary scout hygiene.

loops.before: V6 planned source acquisition, admission, compilation, fitting, commit selection, and evaluation under near-C11 custody.
loops.after: Prepare deterministic complementary rows; verify geometry; fit four clean-base adapters; evaluate frozen held panels; seal and reduce once.
loops.trigger: Implementation begins only after exact human implementation ratification. Model, tokenizer, training, adapter, or GPU execution requires a later separately ratified manifest and independent reviews.
writes: three named implementation files after ratification
loops.stop_condition: Stop on any geometry, hash, path, parser, oracle, interface, spill, or result-seal failure; never retune or replace a failed root after opening results.
loops.rationale: Obtain the writer go/no-go in hours rather than rebuilding the final C11 guard.

claims.before: V6 could have supported correctness-selected child-authored endpoint-policy carriage under a larger custody graph.
claims.after: A complete V7 pass supports only supervised conditional native-action carriage over seen keys under held renderings without detected bound spill or interface damage.
claims.evidence_needed: Both engineered roots pass every optimization, oracle, binding, interface, and spill gate under the separately ratified execution manifest.

cells.reason: It deterministically renders the two complementary target sets.
The writer sees only the target-masked corpus for its own condition, not a map object.
Ordinary generation and likelihood calls receive bound prompts and candidates, not the answer map.
The reducer scores sealed outputs against the frozen maps.
Reviewers verify complement and scoring geometry.
It writes the exact balanced rows and derivation hashes.
Each fit reads only its exact bound corpus.
Evaluation receives held prompts only.
The reducer reads corpus hashes and geometry receipts, not training text.
Reviewers inspect exact bytes and masks.
Held templates and seeds are frozen before fitting.
Held prompts and controls cannot enter fitting.
The evaluator executes exact bound prompts and candidates.
The reducer reads prompt identities and sealed outcomes.
Reviewers inspect the complete held surface.
No result exists during materialization.
Results cannot alter training or retry.
It writes raw immutable outputs and likelihoods.
It computes the frozen labels and report.
Reviewers inspect identical sealed evidence.

acceptance_tests.setup: Materialize both roots repeatedly and mutate root, tool, mode, stratum, mapping, surface, order, target, mask, and seed fields.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exact counts, balance, complement bijection, disjointness, target masking, and matched geometry hold; every mutation fails.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The writer comparison is not a matched complementary intervention.

acceptance_tests.setup: Inspect every training field and run the strict parser table over valid, missing, malformed, multiple, fenced, truncated, and extra-text outputs.
acceptance_tests.expected: No map, oracle, or held content enters training; only one exact ACT parses; invalid cases remain denominator failures.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The result can be driven by answer exposure or parser repair.

acceptance_tests.setup: Inject path escape, symlink, overwrite, hash, cache, adapter-load, partial-stage, and reducer threshold cases including pass, no-learning, spill, oracle-invalid, and interface-invalid fixtures.
acceptance_tests.expected: All integrity faults fail loudly, stage seals are immutable/reproducible, and each fixture receives the frozen label.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A corrupt or result-dependent run can appear valid.

acceptance_tests.setup: One fresh independent implementation reviewer and one separate scientific advocate inspect identical implementation, test, manifest, and dry-run bytes.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both PASS before a later exact execution ratification; independent rejection controls.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The scout is not ready for model, tokenizer, training, adapter, or GPU execution.

human_boundary.decision_question: Approve only the exact compact V7 source implementation and deterministic CPU-test scope while preserving every execution and claim prohibition?
forbidden_before_approval: author the three named implementation files
invoke models, tokenizers, trainers, adapters, or GPUs
make scientific claims or release artifacts
